results.name: detail-target
results.sql: SELECT m.id,m.relative_path,m.size,b.selection,s.title,s.overview FROM media_files m JOIN file_organization o ON o.media_file_id=m.id JOIN metadata_subjects sub ON sub.series_id=o.series_id LEFT JOIN metadata_bindings b ON b.subject_id=sub.id LEFT JOIN metadata_snapshots s ON s.remote_title_id=b.remote_title_id AND s.expires_at>? WHERE m.id=?
queryPlan: SEARCH m USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_media_files_3 (id=?)
SEARCH o USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_file_organization_1 (media_file_id=?)
SEARCH sub USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_metadata_subjects_3 (series_id=?)
SEARCH b USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_metadata_bindings_1 (subject_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_metadata_snapshots_1 (remote_title_id=?) LEFT-JOIN

results.name: library-first-page
results.sql: SELECT e.entry_key,e.local_title,e.added_at,e.file_count,s.title FROM catalog_entries e LEFT JOIN metadata_bindings b ON b.subject_id=e.subject_id LEFT JOIN metadata_snapshots s ON s.remote_title_id=b.remote_title_id AND s.expires_at>? WHERE e.library_id=? AND e.series_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.title_sort_key,e.entry_key LIMIT 50
queryPlan: SEARCH e USING INDEX entries_library_title (library_id=?)
SEARCH b USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_metadata_bindings_1 (subject_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_metadata_snapshots_1 (remote_title_id=?) LEFT-JOIN

results.name: person-50-local-works
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.id,s.title FROM title_credits c JOIN remote_titles r ON r.id=c.remote_title_id JOIN metadata_snapshots s ON s.remote_title_id=r.id AND s.expires_at>? JOIN metadata_bindings b ON b.remote_title_id=r.id JOIN metadata_subjects sub ON sub.id=b.subject_id WHERE c.catalog_id='tmdb' AND c.person_id=? ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 50
queryPlan: SEARCH c USING COVERING INDEX credits_person_works (catalog_id=? AND person_id=?)
SEARCH r USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_remote_titles_1 (id=?)
SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_metadata_snapshots_1 (remote_title_id=?)
SEARCH b USING COVERING INDEX bindings_title (remote_title_id=?)
SEARCH sub USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_metadata_subjects_5 (id=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR DISTINCT
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
